Why Plant Heads & Consultants Choose PowerNext

100% Vendor-Neutral Engineering & Direct Ownership

  • ▸ Zero Locked Component Partners: We build strictly with the switchgear, PLC, VFD, and meter brands specified in your tender or plant maintenance standard.
  • ▸ CAD-First Sign-Off: Fabrication starts only after your engineering team approves our custom GA Drawing, Wiring Schematic, and itemized BOM.
  • ▸ Mandatory 10-Point Pre-Dispatch FAT: Every panel undergoes full injection, HV dielectric, insulation resistance, and load testing in-house.
